item.itunes:author: Dio Chan
item.itunes:summary:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VpUNEeNwUBA

值得閱讀的理由

  • 搶先掌握 FromSoftware 全新 8 人 PVPVE 作品《Twilight Snow-kin》的封測內容與宮崎英高的設計靈感。
  • 深入了解遊戲獨創的四階段淘汰賽制、「美德」取分系統與考驗人性的契約結盟機制。
  • 全面剖析多位「雪眷者」角色的技能定位，以及結合隨機角色扮演與碎片化敘事的「銘刻」系統。

摘要

末日黃昏的始源之血爭奪戰

作者介紹了由 FromSoftware 推出的全新八人線上 PVPVE 新作《Twilight Snow-kin》封測體驗。宮崎英高在採訪中透露，本作核心靈感源自於臨時結盟、動態目標以及多元獲取積分的手段。背景設定在人類紀元步入終結的黃昏時刻，玩家將化身為獲得超常力量的「雪眷者」，跨越時空爭奪「始源之血」。遊戲延續了經典的碎片化敘事，透過角色、物品描述與世界觀細節，讓熱愛拼湊故事的玩家能持續發掘龐大的背景設定。

角色特化與創新的銘刻機制

在測試版本中開放了六名定位鮮明的角色，每位角色均擁有遠近戰能力、兩項主動技「眷術」以及兩項被動技「全能」。例如全能平衡型的艾伯特擅長應對各類局勢，刺客型的莊瀾具備隱身與遮蔽視野的高爆發輸出，而老兵薩米爾則擁有極高的戰術門檻與強力擊飛技能。特別的是，遊戲引入了「銘刻」系統，會賦予玩家隨機目標（如宿敵刺殺、尋找命定戀人等），完成任務可獲取獎勵點數，正式版中更會藉由銘刻組合觸發專屬劇情對話，將角色扮演與敘事完美融合。

四階段生存賽制與策略性取分

作者指出，正式比賽共分為四個階段：首階段不淘汰任何人，讓玩家自由成形機體；第二與第三階段會逐步淘汰點數「美德」最低的玩家，最終僅有三人能晉級至決賽階段展開爭奪。在常規模式中，玩家可以彼此締結「契約」成為同盟，但背叛毀約將面臨生命值上限減少的懲罰。本作打破了傳統純動作比拼的框架，玩家能透過地圖尋找聖物、獵殺怪物等多種手段獲取積分，依靠對規則的理解與路線策略彌補操作差距，展現了高自由度的博弈樂趣。

================================================

Hello everyone, welcome back to my. channel. FromSoftware has brought us an. eight-player online PVPVE title,. Twilight Snow-kin, which recently. started its online test. Having played. it myself, I feel that its rule set is. quite interesting. As Hidetaka Miyazaki. mentioned in a developer interview, one. of the core inspirations for this title. comes from temporary alliances, special. objectives, events, and a multitude of. ways to earn points. Players must. change their strategies at any time,. and with the rule changes in the final. circle of the official version, the. FS-style action system makes the. gameplay feel like a tactical game of. rules. This online test shows a small. fraction of the full game; according to. Miyazaki, he estimates the test content. is likely closer to 20%of the final. version. I discussed this with everyone. during my live stream, and many friends. were very curious about the actual. experience of these rules. Based on. what we’ve seen in the test so far,. combined with the information. officially disclosed, let's talk about. what this game is really about and what. the final version might look like. First, the characters players control. are called "Snow-kin," who gain power. beyond that of humans through the. strength of special blood. As the age. of humanity nears its end, the Blood of. Origin appears at the twilight of. humanity. Thus, the Snow-kin in the. game are summoned to the twilight of. humanity across various eras and. locations to engage in a struggle known. as the "Twilight Battle" to vie for the. Blood of Origin. The game typically. features eight players per match, but. the test version only has six. selectable characters, so seeing. duplicate character teams over the past. few days was inevitable. According to. official interviews, the full version. will feature more than ten characters. Experienced Soulslike players have. surely noticed that this game also. hides various settings in fragmented. descriptions. The characters, items,. and events provided in the test are. only a small portion, but they still. offer a glimpse into the game's. world-building and lore. The "Lore. Hunters" will have their hands full. once again. The focus is on the. character introductions; you can see. that each character has melee and. ranged attack methods, two active. skills called "Snow-kin Arts"—with. the second skill being level-locked,. currently generally available at level. 6 or 12—as well as two passive skills. called "Omnipotence." After playing the. six characters, each person's movement,.

attack performance, and the. characteristics of their active and. passive skills give the characters. distinct, specialized roles. Take the. default tutorial character Albert, for. instance. From his design to his. performance, he's a well-balanced. protagonist. He holds his own in both. ranged and melee combat against mobs. and players alike, and his passive. skill "Rebel" grants an advantage when. facing higher-scoring players in PvP. The athlete wearing autumn-style. clothing, Yang, unlocks the active. skill "Spin" at level 12, which makes. it easy to burst down opponents. With a. passive skill that rewards aggressive. play by restoring health, he leans. towards being a combat specialist that. requires some mechanical skill. Zhuang. Lan can stealth and use skills to deal. heavy damage while obstructing vision,. fitting an assassin archetype that. demands strategy. It's very convenient. for sniping on open maps, but in PvP,. it heavily depends on the player's. experience and how well the character. has been developed. The veteran Samir. feels more like an advanced character; the strategy and mechanical. requirements are quite high. He is the. last character unlocked in the demo; his mobility is the worst, but his. combat power is strong, and if his two. passive skills are used well, they can. provide a huge advantage in battle. Also, don't let the long wind-up on " Human Rocket" fool you; if it hits, it. easily knocks the opponent out of the. arena. When selecting a character,. there is also a mechanic called "Brand,. " which you can choose to use or not. What's interesting is that all the. Brands seen in the test so far relate. to other players. For example, if. someone chooses the "Nemesis" Brand,. another player will get a corresponding. passive Brand, making them the target. for that match. There are also brands. for alliances, and the "Eye of Marr" will randomly assign a target to. eliminate each round, though you have. to use specific actions to identify. them. The funniest one is "Destined. Romance," where you have to find your. fate-ordained lover—it could be a man. or a woman! Completing these Brand. missions will earn you point rewards. According to the developers, this. system is meant to highlight. role-playing, especially with the. randomly assigned passive Brands, which. can bring sudden, dramatic fun to every. match. In the full version, Brands will. be further expanded. Completing. specific combinations can even trigger. exclusive dialogue and reveal new story. fragments, so the game's plot and.

character progression will gradually. unfold as players continue to compete. In the demo version, at the "Mansion of. Karma" hub, you'll find a door on the. second floor you can't enter. In the. full version, there will be NPCs here,. and you can advance the plot by talking. to them. The full version of the game. will offer character customization. content. The character's weapon is. fixed, but blood vessels and skills can. be changed, and you can personalize. their appearance with masks, tattoos,. and other options, which can also be. customized. According to the developers. , the customization in this game isn't. just limited to abilities and. appearance; it also includes aspects. like a character's fate and destiny. The process of driving these. customizations and collections also. serves the function of fragmented. storytelling. Furthermore, obtaining. these doesn't depend on winning matches. —as long as you keep playing, you can. advance the plot and develop your. characters. According to official. interviews, the full version will. gradually reveal the characters ' stories and the world-view through. various details, including character. fates, customizations, and fragmented. narrative elements. There will also be. single-player modes like practice and. an eight-player simulation battle. However, the developers emphasized that. these are just minimal offerings, as. the game's core progression and. strategic experience are still designed. around online play. There are four. tutorial stages at the start of this. beta, and playing through them once. will give you a good grasp of the. game's rules and mechanics. So, what is. it actually like to play a match? The. rules of "Twilight" revolve around a. four-stage match featuring eight. players. The first stage has no. eliminations, allowing everyone to. build up and figure out their. character's playstyle. In the second. stage, the two players with the lowest. score, known as "Virtue," are. eliminated. In the third stage, the. three players who successfully advance. enter the final stage. Players will. have two lives in this final round and. receive bonus HP based on the points. they earned previously. The three-way. battle concludes with the winner. receiving the "Moon's Grace." The full. version will feature a mode where the. final round is not PVP, but a PVE co-op. battle against a boss. The beta shows. both ranked and casual modes. The. default standard mode allows you to. form "pacts" with other players, which. automatically dissolve before the final.

battle. You can also break a pact at. the end of each stage, but the player. who initiates the break will have some. of their max HP transferred as. compensation. The "No-Pact" mode is. self-explanatory, while the "Pact" mode. starts with pairs of two, and once you. form a pact, it stays active until the. end. Once matched and in the game,. players can choose their spawn area at. the start of each stage, though the. specific location is random. You can. choose your spot based on the. characteristics displayed for each area. —for example, red icons indicate a. higher chance to get active skill. upgrades, while gray icons make it. easier to upgrade weapons. These will. change each stage. Outside of the. beginning of a stage, respawning,. teleporting, or being in combat, you. can teleport to any location you wish. to explore at any time. The setting is. rooted in a vampire theme. For this. test, the developers chose the most. intuitive Gothic Victorian-style street. map, and there will be at least three. maps available at the full release. Based on my actual hands-on time so far. , because the characters in this game. are highly mobile and the map is vast,. every area has plenty of diverse,. distinct environments to explore. But. since this game starts eliminating. players in the second or third round,. who has the spare time to wander around. exploring? Shouldn't you be focused on. efficiently collecting points. everywhere? This brings me to what I. find most interesting: the variety of. ways to earn points. The developers. mentioned they wanted to design a game. that players with less action-gaming. experience could still enjoy. Players. can compensate for mechanical skill. gaps through their understanding of the. rules, strategic choices, and character. builds. In the first match of this test. , I felt the gameplay strangely. resembled the competitive mode of Kirby. Air Ride, where players can lean into. their own strengths within the rules. while the core framework remains fair. for everyone. The core of the game is. collecting "Virtues" for points, and. there are countless ways to get them. You can light up the relics scattered. across the map; finding large relics. grants a good amount of points, but. only for the first person to find them. Additionally, killing various common. enemies also gives you a chance to loot. Virtues. The common enemies are. designed to be easy to fight, and since. your character’s HP and attack power. increase rapidly as you level up and. gain various buffs, you don't need to. fear being swarmed by mobs. With a.

suitable character and some experience,. even elite enemies aren't that. difficult. You must defeat elite. enemies to obtain "Slaying Virtues." As. for the bosses known as "Invaders," there are two types: regular and. powerful, though neither is. particularly difficult for players with. experience in Soulslikes. Regardless,. when you encounter a boss, an automatic. call for co-op is sent to nearby. players. Those who accept will be. teleported in, making the fight much. more flexible when working together. After winning, participants are. rewarded with Slaying Virtues, which. can strengthen your character's "Blood. Power" for that match; they are quite. useful, and you can equip up to five at. once. If you're not confident in your. skills and want to avoid bosses,. actively choosing whether or not to. trigger or join a boss fight based on. your character’s traits and the. current situation is actually a key. part of the match strategy. It really. doesn't matter; you can just run around. the map killing mobs you can handle and. scavenging for items instead. Defeating. various types of enemies earns you the. "Blood Battle" commendation, while. collecting items earns you "Collector's. Points." The rarer or newer the item,. the higher the points you receive. At. the end of each phase, the top two. players in each battlefield ranking. will receive rewards. So, players with. strong combat skills and experience can. take on tougher enemies for points,. while those who find it challenging can. still earn points by roaming the map,. defeating regular monsters, and. collecting items. Furthermore, the game. features two types of allied mechanics. One is the balance bar shared by. players and enemies; when broken, you. can perform a unique roar, and after. filling the gauge, you can drain the. enemy’s life to turn them into a. temporary pet that fights for you. However, because players are highly. mobile and dash around quickly, these. pets are useful in a specific area but. cannot keep up with you over long. distances. This is where the other very. important type of ally, the "Familiars,. " comes in. These Familiars are linked. to three types of magic seals, each. summoning different types with unique. traits; I’ve discovered six so far. For instance, one magic seal summons a. male singer that buffs physical and. posture defense, while another, the. undead Marlo, looks weak but can throw. poison, self-destruct, and lure enemies. —making him extremely disruptive. These Familiars can also be leveled up. to increase their HP and attack power,.

with a level cap of five. They will. gradually unlock two to three abilities. and will follow the player throughout. the journey. Depending on your. playstyle, bringing the right Familiar. provides a significant boost,. especially for less skilled players, as. cultivating a powerful one will make. your combat efforts much more efficient. . Moreover, in the official match,. different Familiars and whether or not. you actively participate in various. events may influence the outcome of the. final battle. Also, since Familiars are. AI-controlled, their movement is. predictably less optimal than a human. player's, but their disruptive. potential cannot be ignored, so many. players tend to prioritize taking out. the opponent’s Familiar in PVP. However, this "mantis stalks the cicada. " scenario creates opportunities for. characters with slow, wind-up heavy. skills or less agile movement to strike. when the opponent is focused elsewhere. Try to summon a Familiar as early as. possible in the match, and you can then. collect character or Familiar shards. through dropped items or by scavenging. the map. If you are afraid of bosses,. it’s fine; just defeat regular. enemies on the map or pick up items to. upgrade your stats. Once some character. skills are fully upgraded, they become. significantly more effective. The. alchemy furnace can be used to upgrade. weapons, allowing you to add elemental. effects and other properties. The same. alchemy furnace can also be used for. further upgrades. Regardless of the. methods you use, as your character. gradually develops and your build. matures, and as your Familiars grow. stronger, the second and third stages. of the match will become a true proving. ground. Perhaps the characters are just. too mobile. Generally, when players. cross paths, if one side doesn't want. to fight and runs away, the other finds. it hard to catch up. Besides, even if. you manage to kill them, there’s no. point reward, so it’s not really. worth it. To engage in PvP, you need to. go to the ritual site. Taking down. others here earns you the Virtue of. Swords, or you can find the Sigil. Pillars; interacting with them takes. about 8 seconds to grant you the Virtue. of Oaths. Sometimes, while others are. busy fighting, it’s easy to sneak in. and steal it. But before the round ends. , others can also interact with it to. take your Virtue of Oaths back, so it. really tests your strategy. The ritual. sites also feature easily identifiable. silver and gold stones. You can only. carry one set at a time, and they will. increase the Virtue of Swords or Virtue.

of Oaths you earn within the ritual. site. If you enter a ritual site and. decide to run because you’re losing,. you will suffer a damage penalty. Beyond these mechanics, there are also. the previously mentioned Marks; completing Mark objectives also rewards. you with Virtues. During the match,. various random events will occur. I. encountered five different types, some. of which significantly buff your. character, others aid in combat, and. some allow you to gain a large amount. of Virtue if you seize the chance,. helping you rank up. The developers. mentioned considering mechanics to. foster interaction between beginners. and veterans, potentially including. more targeted special events. From my. experience with the beta, this entire. Virtue-gathering system means PvP or. PvE are just ways to score; exploration. , events, Marks, and even relying on. Familiars are all viable methods. If. you enjoy combat, while the game is. built on a Soulslike foundation and. isn't as flashy as dedicated action. games, it still has advanced mechanics. Precise parries, using Roar to quickly. build up the stagger gauge, and timing. your dodges and skills all require. practice. On the other hand, you can. focus on exploration and adaptability,. adjusting your strategy to win. For. instance, if you don't like PvP, why. not use Familiars? Through character. builds and Familiars, you still have a. chance; this system reduces the. reliance on pure action skill to some. extent. And if you just love to hunt. players, the full version will even. introduce a 9th player invasion. mechanic, allowing someone to enter the. battlefield with rules different from. the eight regular participants. The. current network test is only a small. part of the full version, and many. systems have been simplified to help. players understand the game quickly. It’s too early to tell if the full. version of Dusk Tribe will be a success. or how rich its content will be; nobody. knows yet. However, at least according. to the information revealed by the. officials, the official version will. include character customization, more. enemies, fragmented storytelling,. companion progression, and different. final battle modes, as well as more. maps at launch and the possibility of. the developers continuing to adjust the. balance of PvP in the overall game. So,. does FromSoftware have a chance? This. time, by turning the PvPvE into a. multiplayer game where different types. of players can find their own fun, I. hope it will continue to grow after the. official release. Alright, that's it.

for today's video. Thank you all for. watching, and if you liked it, don't. forget to like and subscribe.

The full. version will feature a mode where the. final round is not PVP, but a PVE co-op. battle against a boss. The beta shows. both ranked and casual modes. The. default standard mode allows you to. form "pacts" with other players, which. automatically dissolve before the final.

battle. You can also break a pact at. the end of each stage, but the player. who initiates the break will have some. of their max HP transferred as. compensation. Once matched and in the game,. players can choose their spawn area at. the start of each stage, though the. specific location is random. You can. choose your spot based on the. characteristics displayed for each area. —for example, red icons indicate a. higher chance to get active skill. upgrades, while gray icons make it. easier to upgrade weapons. These will. change each stage. Outside of the. beginning of a stage, respawning,. teleporting, or being in combat, you. can teleport to any location you wish. to explore at any time. The setting is. rooted in a vampire theme. For this. test, the developers chose the most. intuitive Gothic Victorian-style street. map, and there will be at least three. maps available at the full release. Based on my actual hands-on time so far. , because the characters in this game. are highly mobile and the map is vast,. every area has plenty of diverse,. distinct environments to explore. But. since this game starts eliminating. players in the second or third round,. who has the spare time to wander around. exploring? Shouldn't you be focused on. efficiently collecting points. everywhere? This brings me to what I. find most interesting: the variety of. ways to earn points. The developers. mentioned they wanted to design a game. that players with less action-gaming. experience could still enjoy. Players. can compensate for mechanical skill. gaps through their understanding of the. rules, strategic choices, and character. builds. Air Ride, where players can lean into. their own strengths within the rules. while the core framework remains fair. for everyone. Additionally, killing various common. enemies also gives you a chance to loot. Virtues. suitable character and some experience,. even elite enemies aren't that. difficult. You must defeat elite. enemies to obtain "Slaying Virtues." Regardless,. when you encounter a boss, an automatic. call for co-op is sent to nearby. players. Those who accept will be. teleported in, making the fight much. more flexible when working together. "Blood Battle" commendation, while. collecting items earns you "Collector's. Points." The rarer or newer the item,. the higher the points you receive. At. the end of each phase, the top two. players in each battlefield ranking. will receive rewards. One is the balance bar shared by. players and enemies; when broken, you. can perform a unique roar, and after. filling the gauge, you can drain the. enemy’s life to turn them into a. temporary pet that fights for you. However, because players are highly. mobile and dash around quickly, these. pets are useful in a specific area but. cannot keep up with you over long. distances. This is where the other very. important type of ally, the "Familiars,. " comes in. These Familiars are linked. to three types of magic seals, each. summoning different types with unique. traits; I’ve discovered six so far. with a level cap of five. They will. gradually unlock two to three abilities. and will follow the player throughout. the journey. Depending on your. playstyle, bringing the right Familiar. provides a significant boost,. especially for less skilled players, as. cultivating a powerful one will make. your combat efforts much more efficient. . AI-controlled, their movement is. predictably less optimal than a human. player's, but their disruptive. potential cannot be ignored, so many. players tend to prioritize taking out. the opponent’s Familiar in PVP. Try to summon a Familiar as early as. possible in the match, and you can then. collect character or Familiar shards. through dropped items or by scavenging. the map. Once some character. skills are fully upgraded, they become. significantly more effective. The. alchemy furnace can be used to upgrade. weapons, allowing you to add elemental. effects and other properties. The same. alchemy furnace can also be used for. further upgrades. Regardless of the. methods you use, as your character. gradually develops and your build. matures, and as your Familiars grow. stronger, the second and third stages. of the match will become a true proving. ground. Perhaps the characters are just. too mobile. Generally, when players. cross paths, if one side doesn't want. to fight and runs away, the other finds. it hard to catch up. Besides, even if. you manage to kill them, there’s no. point reward, so it’s not really. worth it. To engage in PvP, you need to. go to the ritual site. Taking down. others here earns you the Virtue of. Swords, or you can find the Sigil. Pillars; interacting with them takes. about 8 seconds to grant you the Virtue. of Oaths. Sometimes, while others are. busy fighting, it’s easy to sneak in. and steal it. But before the round ends. , others can also interact with it to. take your Virtue of Oaths back, so it. really tests your strategy. of Oaths you earn within the ritual. site. If you enter a ritual site and. decide to run because you’re losing,. you will suffer a damage penalty. for today's video. Thank you all for. watching, and if you liked it, don't. forget to like and subscribe.

  • 深入了解遊戲獨創的四階段淘汰賽制、「美德」取分系統與考驗人性的契約結盟機制。
  • 全面剖析多位「雪眷者」角色的技能定位，以及結合隨機角色扮演與碎片化敘事的「銘刻」系統。

摘要

末日黃昏的始源之血爭奪戰

作者介紹了由 FromSoftware 推出的全新八人線上 PVPVE 新作《Twilight Snow-kin》封測體驗。宮崎英高在採訪中透露，本作核心靈感源自於臨時結盟、動態目標以及多元獲取積分的手段。背景設定在人類紀元步入終結的黃昏時刻，玩家將化身為獲得超常力量的「雪眷者」，跨越時空爭奪「始源之血」。遊戲延續了經典的碎片化敘事，透過角色、物品描述與世界觀細節，讓熱愛拼湊故事的玩家能持續發掘龐大的背景設定。

角色特化與創新的銘刻機制

在測試版本中開放了六名定位鮮明的角色，每位角色均擁有遠近戰能力、兩項主動技「眷術」以及兩項被動技「全能」。例如全能平衡型的艾伯特擅長應對各類局勢，刺客型的莊瀾具備隱身與遮蔽視野的高爆發輸出，而老兵薩米爾則擁有極高的戰術門檻與強力擊飛技能。特別的是，遊戲引入了「銘刻」系統，會賦予玩家隨機目標（如宿敵刺殺、尋找命定戀人等），完成任務可獲取獎勵點數，正式版中更會藉由銘刻組合觸發專屬劇情對話，將角色扮演與敘事完美融合。

四階段生存賽制與策略性取分

作者指出，正式比賽共分為四個階段：首階段不淘汰任何人，讓玩家自由成形機體；第二與第三階段會逐步淘汰點數「美德」最低的玩家，最終僅有三人能晉級至決賽階段展開爭奪。在常規模式中，玩家可以彼此締結「契約」成為同盟，但背叛毀約將面臨生命值上限減少的懲罰。本作打破了傳統純動作比拼的框架，玩家能透過地圖尋找聖物、獵殺怪物等多種手段獲取積分，依靠對規則的理解與路線策略彌補操作差距，展現了高自由度的博弈樂趣。

item.title: 第三方移植范本？匹诺曹的谎言Switch 2体验
item.itunes:title: 第三方移植范本？匹诺曹的谎言Switch 2体验
item.itunes:author: Dio Chan
item.itunes:summary:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Why90FNlJMI

值得閱讀的理由

  • 深入了解《匹諾曹的謊言》在 Switch 2 上的移植水準，以及畫質、平衡、性能三檔模式的具體表現。
  • 全面掌握包含資料片與各項平衡更新的完整版內容特色與遊玩建議。
  • 解析遊戲獨創的武器組裝、謊言抉擇系統以及黑暗童話風格的世界觀設計。

摘要

Switch 2 移植表現與畫面模式解析

作者指出《匹諾曹的謊言》正式登陸 Switch 2，實體版採用常規卡帶，數位版約需 37GB 以上空間，並完整收錄了包含資料片與後續平衡更新的完整版內容。本作的移植表現堪稱第三方大型遊戲在 Switch 2 上的示範範本。

遊戲在主機與掌機模式下皆提供三種畫面檔位：畫質模式（30幀）擁有最高的細節與特效，但操作存在遲滯感；性能模式（60幀）雖降低了部分解析度與材質，但能帶來極佳的穩定流暢度；位於中間的平衡模式（40幀）在掌機上搭配 VRR 技術，能同時兼具比性能模式更清晰的畫面與順暢的視覺體驗，讓玩家可依需求自由選擇。

黑暗童話世界觀與謊言抉擇機制

本作以經典童話進行顛覆性的重新詮釋，打造出充滿發條朋克風格與詭譎氛圍的人偶城市「克拉特」。玩家扮演人偶主角 P 調查傀儡狂暴背後的真相。遊戲將核心設定「說謊」融入主線，玩家在殘酷真相與善意謊言之間的抉擇，將深刻影響 P 自身的人性變化與世界走向。

戰鬥系統、深度客製化與資料片拓展

戰鬥機制強調防禦與精準格擋，並擁有高度自由的武器組合系統，玩家可隨意拆裝刀刃與刀柄以獲得不同的攻擊動作與屬性加成，搭配軍團義手與 P器官 強化，構建多樣化的戰鬥流派。地圖設計則承襲魂系經典的捷徑與埋伏惡意，探索張力十足。當進度推進至第九章時還能開啟資料片內容，透過時空穿越補完劇情謎團，並解鎖新地圖、強敵與新武裝。

=============

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Why90FNlJMI

这种主/掌机下都用明确锁定帧率的3档模式挺不错的
